channel.title: The Monday Morning Drip
channel.description: Pediatric med ed for the busy educator

item.title: Issue 2: "Ready" has to be proven now.
item.description: The ABP just opened a 2-year fellowship path in 7 subspecialties for programs that can show readiness with EPAs. That makes trustworthy assessment data priceless, and a JGME study finds AI summaries of rotation comments catch most strengths but miss most areas for improvement. On the recruitment side, signals dominate who gets an interview, and a small PHM pilot shows how far a structured mentoring cohort can move confidence.

item.title: Issue 1: "Ready for what?"
item.description: Pediatric PDs feel a heavy moral duty to call graduates practice-ready but define readiness differently, just as the ABP moves to EPA-based attestations in 2028. On the way in, pediatrics-specific signals (the NBME shelf, clerkship honors, GHHS) modestly predict early Milestones. Once residents arrive, the hidden struggles are about adapting to the workplace, and Academic Pediatrics shows how help-seeking and autonomy develop along the way.
